title: DXC Introduces Frontier Code Assurance, a Managed Code Security Service Built on Claude Mythos
headline: DXC launches AI-driven code security service using Claude Mythos
summary: DXC Technology has launched Frontier Code Assurance, a managed cybersecurity service that uses Anthropic’s Claude Mythos AI model to identify, validate, and remediate software vulnerabilities. The service combines AI-driven vulnerability discovery with human cybersecurity specialists to rank business impact and provide a prioritised remediation roadmap. It builds on an existing partnership announced in June 2026 and is available immediately.
why_it_matters: Organisations adopting AI for vulnerability discovery must pair automated model outputs with specialist human oversight to prioritise remediation and maintain auditable evidence for mission-critical software.

quotes.text: DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC), a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner, today launched DXC Frontier Code Assurance, a cybersecurity service that uses Anthropic’s Claude Mythos AI model to help enterprises find, validate, and help remediate vulnerabilities in mission-critical software.

As AI accelerates the discovery of vulnerabilities, the bottleneck has shifted from finding flaws to prioritising and executing the remediation path. Frontier Code Assurance is built for that challenge.

classification.significance_reason: Vendor product launch introducing an AI-assisted code security and remediation service without specific regulatory or compliance mandate changes.
